Rafael (eng-platform): :rotating_light: Grafana alert: missing child spans for payments-service traces since ~09:13. root spans still there but no db/cache calls. Anyone seeing this?
Mei (observability): seeing it in trace ingest metrics — exported_spans dropped ~90% for payment routes since 09:12. dashboards look like exporter ack rate is stalled.
Jonah (eng-infra): pulling collector logs now, one sec.
Jonah (eng-infra): logs show repeated 429 from the edge proxy when forwarding OTLP: 
```
2026-03-18T09:12:41Z exporter/otlp.go:145 send failed: http 429 {"error":"quota exceeded","route_id":"route-453"}
2026-03-18T09:12:42Z exporter/otlp.go:145 send failed: http 429 {"error":"quota exceeded","route_id":"route-453"}
```
Mei (observability): interesting — collector still batching, but backend rejects with 429. that would explain missing children (they never reach backend).
Priya (edge): we rolled out per-route quotas at 09:10 to limit noisy API endpoints (ticket #PLAT-981). The rule matches `/api/*` and applies quotas by token. Could otlp be under that path?
Jonah (eng-infra): yes — our OTLP collector uses the legacy path `/api/v1/otlp` when behind the proxy. new quota rule didn't exclude telemetry.
Rafael (eng-platform): confirmed in exporter logs: 429 response includes header `x-rate-limit-route: enforced`. sample curl to repro: 
```
curl -v -X POST https://edge.redwood.internal/api/v1/otlp/v1/traces -d '{}' -H 'Content-Type: application/x-protobuf'
> HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
< x-rate-limit-route: enforced\n
```
Marco (platform-ops): whoops. rolling back the quota rule for `/api/*` now and adding an explicit exemption for `/_telemetry` and `api/v1/otlp` endpoints.
deploy-bot: Deployment started: disable-rule/route-453 by Marco — in progress.
Jonah (eng-infra): collector ack rate recovering, exporter retries succeeding again.
Mei (observability): traces flowing back in — child spans reappeared at 09:21. counts back to normal by 09:24.
Rafael (eng-platform): great. logging incident for postmortem. immediate remediation: roll back rule + add telemetry-exempt tag to route configs.
Priya (edge): will update the rollout pipeline to exclude any path matching telemetry prefixes and add a dry-run smoke test that sends an OTLP trace after quota changes.
Marco (platform-ops): action items: 1) exempt telemetry routes (done), 2) add smoke test, 3) add alert that flags exporter 429s from edge proxy. I'll open follow-up tickets.
Mei (observability): also adding a dashboard panel that surfaces 429/error responses for exporter endpoints specifically.
Rafael (eng-platform): thanks — folks, remember to include the telemetry-exempt flag in any future routing policy PRs. Adding owners to the incident doc now. :thumbsup:
